title: Critique: whatever closes the gap is open to the non-panpsychist

statements.text: Each way a panpsychist might close the gap, hidden properties, a bonding relation, psychophysical laws or fusion, is equally available without microexperience, and more economical there. So, Goff argued in 2009, the need to explain consciousness gives no reason to be a panpsychist.

sources.quote: the paper argues that panpsychism cannot help us to explain consciousness, at least not the kind of consciousness we have pre-theoretical reason to believe in
My point is that the way the panpsychist gets round the combination problem, i.e. by investing in a phenomenal bonding relation, is open to the non-panpsychist.
